definition: A typed data object that flows between Tools — the 'materials' of the laboratory (e.g. a seed/observation, an IA Cloud, a (windowed) light curve, a candidate set, a (q0,ω) state, a ρ-band result). An artifact's TYPE is itself a glossary term, so the glossary doubles as the port type-system: a Tool's input/output signature is written in artifact types (e.g. the IA-Cloud-generator Tool is seed → IA Cloud). Instances are today loose NPZ/JSON files referenced by run records; reifying them as typed, addressable materials is open laboratory work.
